rules: Read the actual default font and available styles before measuring text and generating layout.
Save resolved family, style, native binding and observation evidence in Adapter Metadata for the target task.
Do not guess a family name or silently substitute an unavailable weight or glyph.
Default-font resolution or glyph coverage failure is Missing or Unsupported, never PASS.
Preserve existing version locks, registry admissions and historical evidence bytes.
Changing fonts in an admitted component requires new measurements and native fidelity admission in a new version.
